notes.title: Minor update: added more tips
notes.notes: Added a tip that recommends starting a new run on a higher difficulty mode after surviving 20 waves.

notes.title: Minor update: camera scrolling speed and more camera tips
notes.notes:
Added an option to control the camera's movement speed when moving your mouse to the edges of the screen. 

Added additional tips for moving, zooming and rotating the camera.

notes.title: Citadelic demo update: stats and UX improvements
notes.notes:
A new update to the demo version of Citadelic has been released. It includes the following changes:

[list]
[*] Statistics are shown at the end of each run.
[*] Active upgrades and augments of a structure are now visible when moving your cursor over it.
[*] Camera rotation sensitivity can be changed in the Settings. The tooltip there also explains that middle mouse button can be held in-game to rotate the camera.
[*] Game controller hints are not visible if the player is using a mouse when a controller is plugged in.
[*] Minor text changes when selecting modifiers and difficulty.
[*] Camera is zoomed in closer to the game area by default.
[*] Structure customization tooltips now show a hint that right click can be used to unselect the structure.
[*] Keyboard can be used to close in-game tooltips and panels (backspace by default).
[/list]

notes.title: Demo update
notes.notes:
- Fixed a rare bug that could cause a crash. (Thanks to Retromation for finding this!)
- Added more tips for beginners.
- Reduced background transparency for tooltips to improve readability.
